h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dehri

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dehri

items.pText: Dehri, also called Dehri-on-Sone, sits on the bank of the Sone river in Rohtas district, south-west Bihar. Its schools, railway colonies and residential areas are our likely buyers. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,320 km from Dehri, and sends it by road for installation by our team or a dealer serving Bihar.

If you are planning a playground for the first time, a clear enquiry saves a lot of back-and-forth. We need to know how big the space is, who will use it and what the ground is like. With that, we can suggest equipment and draw a layout in one round. Below is what to send. Dehri's summers are very hot and the monsoon is heavy, so tell us about shade and drainage too.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: What to send us for a quick, accurate quote

items: The length and width of the space, even if rough. Note any trees, poles, walls or drains inside it.
The age group of the children and roughly how many will play at once.
Photos of the ground from each corner, and one taken in the afternoon to show shade.

c: Send these to sales@funplaysystems.com or call +91 902 830 2266, Monday to Saturday. We reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. Browse our
if you already have pieces in mind. See our

facts.value: About 1,320 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What information do you need to suggest playground equipment?
items.a: The size of the space, the age group and number of children, and photos of the ground. Mention trees, walls, drains and shade, since these affect where each piece can go.
Rough measurements are enough to start. We use them for the first layout drawing, and you can confirm exact dimensions before approving the layout and quote.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Dehri-on-Sone?
items.a: Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai and send it to Dehri by road. Our team or a dealer serving Bihar installs it.
